about: Adroit Industries is a vertically integrated maker of propeller shafts (drive shafts) and related torque-transmission components, with in-house forging, machining, heat treatment, assembly and testing. It offers over 5,000 SKUs for automotive (mainly commercial vehicles) and non-automotive uses such as defence, heavy equipment and off-highway machinery. It operates three facilities in Madhya Pradesh (Dewas, Pithampur, Sanwer) and exports to over 32 countries, with exports about 95% of product sales.
headquarters: Bhiwandi (Thane), Maharashtra (registered office); plants in Madhya Pradesh

objects.purpose: Capex at Dewas Facility (forging machinery and transport vehicle) by the Company
Investment in subsidiary Adroit Driveshafts for capex at Pithampur Facility
Investment in subsidiary for repayment/prepayment of its borrowings

promoters.background: Mukesh Sangla acquired control in 2007 and has over four decades of business experience; Saurabh Sangla has over 18 years in torque transmission. Promoter Group Selling Shareholder is Mukesh Sangla HUF.

concentration.note: Top 10 customers were 60.86% of product sales in FY26 (65.91% FY25, 68.61% FY24); exports were 95.39% of product sales, mostly to the United States.

litigation_note: No outstanding criminal or material civil cases or regulatory actions against the Company. Promoter Mukesh Sangla faces a cheque-dishonour complaint (Rs 50 lakh) linked to Signet Industries. Customs duty contingent liabilities of Rs 4.66 million and Rs 0.32 million are under appeal.
strengths: Vertically integrated: forging, machining, heat treatment, assembly and testing are done in-house across three Madhya Pradesh plants.
Broad range of over 5,000 SKUs of propeller shafts and driveline parts, rising from 3,821 in FY24 to 5,250.
Strong export reach: sold to over 32 countries, with exports about 95% of product sales.
Profitability improving: EBITDA margin rose to 27.66% and PAT margin to 18.69% in FY26 from 23.84% and 11.67% in FY24.
Return ratios healthy: RoNW 22.51% and RoCE 19.01% in FY26.
Leverage falling: debt-to-equity dropped from 0.94 in FY24 to 0.41 in FY26.
Repeat customers gave 90.26% of FY26 revenue and customers older than 3 years gave 71.91% of product sales.
Positive operating cash flow of Rs 29.41 crore in FY26; IPO funds earmarked for capacity and subsidiary debt repayment.

risks.title: Heavy export and US dependence
risks.detail: Exports were 95.39% of product sales in FY26 (96.27% FY25), concentrated in the United States. Tariffs, trade-policy changes or a US slowdown could hurt revenue.

risks.title: Customer concentration
risks.detail: Top 10 customers contributed 60.86% of product sales in FY26 (65.91% FY25, 68.61% FY24). Loss of a key customer would hit revenue.

risks.title: Currency risk with no hedging policy
risks.detail: Rs 121.24 crore of FY26 revenue came from outside India and the company has no hedging policy, so rupee swings can hit earnings.

risks.title: Compliance lapses
risks.detail: Multiple delayed ROC filings, some delayed up to 3,771 days (for example MGT-14 and AOC-4 forms), which suggests weak internal compliance controls and penalty risk.

risks.title: Single-state manufacturing and subsidiary dependence
risks.detail: All three plants are in Madhya Pradesh, and downstream machining runs through subsidiary Adroit Driveshafts (Pithampur), so any disruption there affects the whole chain.

risks.title: Promoter control and OFS exit
risks.detail: Promoters hold 96.10% pre-IPO and will keep control after the offer. Company gets nothing from the Rs 18.09 crore offer for sale.

risks.title: High working capital and inventory days
risks.detail: Net working capital is 237 days, inventory 135 days and debtors 111 days in FY26, tying up cash. Debtor days rose from 98 in FY25.

risks.title: Promoter litigation and past IPO withdrawals
risks.detail: Promoter Mukesh Sangla faces a cheque-dishonour complaint of Rs 50 lakh. The company also withdrew SME IPO drafts in 2011 and 2017. Customs duty disputes total about Rs 0.50 crore.

notes: Source is the final Prospectus; figures restated consolidated, originally in Rs million, converted to Rs crore. Offer price fixed at Rs 134 (band Rs 126-134); P/E 17.91 is at the cap price and no post-issue P/E is stated. Balance sheet text was garbled; borrowings = non-current + current borrowings, cash_and_bank = cash plus other bank balances, cross-checked against debt/equity 0.41/0.63/0.94. Promoter post-offer holding computed from 33,549,334 pre-offer promoter-group shares less 1,350,000 OFS shares over 44,808,340 post shares. Reservation: 50% QIB (60% of it anchor, shown as 30% of offer), 15% NII, 35% retail. ROE not reported; founded_year is incorporation year (business began 1966 as a partnership). EPS reflects the 1:1 bonus of Feb 2026. Net worth excludes NCI.
